variance_decomposition_nested_r2_active.note: nested-model R2 of rating variance explained by game identity, rater identity, and additive two-way fit on active set

severity_reliability_by_band_active.note: signal/noise decomposition of parity-half severity estimates on active set; min 10 per half

game_fe_regression.note: rating ~ band dummies + game fixed effects; exact within-game demeaning; SEs clustered by game

variance_decomposition.note: nested-model R2 of rating variance explained by game identity (raw game mean), rater identity (raw user mean), and the additive two-way fit. Marginal effect moments are not used because they double-count under unbalanced correlated factors.

severity_reliability_by_band.note: signal/noise decomposition of parity-half severity estimates; single-rating users are excluded because no half estimate exists

comparison_table.note: Active is primary (16,627 games × >=10 active users, minus strict, 24.5M obs); historical references are 16,627×all-users (25.3M obs) and full-snapshot 95,540×all-users (26.9M obs). Pooled gaps on active use 10-24 as low (since 1..9 excluded); historical gaps use 1 as low.

rows.comment: Active gaps smaller because low floor raised from 1 to 10; compare within-game gaps for selection vs level shift
Ordered by lifetime volume; active spread excludes 1..9 bands so narrower

rows.active_users_note: >=10 active ratings minus 667 strict; 52.98% of filtered
